oom.title: Not enough GPU memory
oom.explanation: The run requested more video memory than available and stopped. No adapter was published and resources were released. The preflight estimate is only indicative: it does not guarantee that training fits.
actions: Lower the per-device batch and raise gradient accumulation to keep the effective batch.
Lower the maximum sequence length.
Use QLoRA instead of LoRA or choose a smaller base model.
Create a new run from this configuration with those changes.

incomplete_download.title: Incomplete base model download
incomplete_download.explanation: The download of the exact revision stopped before finishing. Partial files never count as a ready model and DashAI does not switch to another revision.
actions: Check the internet connection and free disk space.
If the model needs a credential, make sure it is set in Credentials.
Start a new run: the download is retried from scratch.

interrupted.title: Run interrupted
interrupted.explanation: DashAI was closed or the training process ended unexpectedly. The run keeps its configuration, log and the phase it reached, but it did not publish an adapter.
actions: Create a new run from this configuration.
Avoid closing DashAI while training is in progress.

invalid_data_full.title: Invalid data in the full dataset
invalid_data_full.explanation: The preview was validated on a sample, but validating every row found an empty value. DashAI never repairs or drops rows silently.
actions: Fix or remove the reported row in the dataset.
Re-import the dataset and review the validation in the Data step.
Create a new run.

mask_invalid.title: Invalid loss mask
mask_invalid.explanation: Truncating to the maximum length left some examples without response tokens. DashAI does not fall back to training on every token: the loss is computed on responses only.
actions: Increase the maximum sequence length.
Shorten the instruction or context of those examples.
Review the SFT examples in the Data step.

nan_loss.title: Non-finite loss (NaN)
nan_loss.explanation: The loss stopped being a finite number and the run was stopped so that no corrupted adapter is published.
actions: Lower the learning rate (for example, halve it).
Check the training data for anomalous examples.
Repeat a controlled run and review the log.

grad_norm_warning.title: Non-finite gradient norms
grad_norm_warning.explanation: The run finished but logged NaN grad_norm at some steps. Finishing does not prove stability: review the result before trusting the adapter.
actions: Review the flagged steps in the log.
Compare the adapter with the base model on the held-out cases.
Repeat a controlled run with a lower learning rate.

missing_adapter.title: Adapter missing
missing_adapter.explanation: The run finished successfully, but the adapter files are no longer available. The run stays Finished; the adapter cannot be used in chat.
actions: Restore the adapter files to their location.
Train a new run with the same configuration.

gpu_busy.title: GPU busy
gpu_busy.explanation: Another process is using the GPU. Runs wait in the queue and generation does not run until it is free.
gpu_busy.trainingExplanation: The GPU is busy with a training run; with a single GPU, generation does not run in parallel. Wait for it to finish or cancel it.
actions: Wait until the GPU is free.
Check the job queue to identify the active process.

cancelled.title: Run cancelled
cancelled.explanation: The run was cancelled. It keeps its configuration and log; retrying creates a new run.
actions: Create a new run from this configuration.

adapter_missing.title: Adapter not available
adapter_missing.explanation: The selected adapter is missing or invalid. DashAI does not answer with the base model instead.
actions: Choose another available adapter.
Restore the adapter files or train it again.

base_missing.title: Base model not available
base_missing.explanation: The required base model is not downloaded or is invalid. Download it before generating.
actions: Download the exact revision of the base model.
Choose another available model.

empty_value.title: Empty values
empty_value.explanation: Some rows have an empty instruction or response. An example without a response adds nothing to the loss, and DashAI does not drop it silently.
actions: Fill in the reported rows.
Remove them explicitly from the dataset and re-import it.

missing_column.title: Missing column
missing_column.explanation: The mapping points to a column that does not exist, or a required field is not assigned.
actions: Review the column mapping.
Confirm the format.

invalid_json.title: Invalid JSON
invalid_json.explanation: The messages column does not hold a valid JSON list of turns with role and content.
actions: Fix the JSON of the reported rows.
Re-import the dataset.

unsupported_role.title: Unsupported role
unsupported_role.explanation: Only the system, user and assistant roles are supported. Tools and multimodal content are not supported.
actions: Normalize the roles of those conversations.
Remove the affected conversations.

no_assistant.title: No assistant response
no_assistant.explanation: Some conversations have no assistant message, so there is nothing to supervise.
actions: Add the expected response.
Remove those conversations.

too_long.title: Examples too long
too_long.explanation: Some examples exceed the maximum length and will be truncated. They keep supervised tokens, so this is only a warning.
actions: Increase the maximum length if memory allows.
Shorten those examples.

truncation_kills_response.title: Truncation removes the response
truncation_kills_response.explanation: With the current maximum length, the response of some examples is cut off entirely and there would be no supervised tokens.
actions: Increase the maximum length.
Shorten the instruction or context.

help.maxLength: Tokens per example after applying the chat template. Longer sequences use more memory.
help.learningRate: Size of each update. Typical values for LoRA: 1e-4 to 3e-4.
help.batchSize: Examples processed at once on the GPU. It has the largest effect on memory.
help.gradAccum: Accumulates gradients over several batches before updating; does not increase memory.
help.loraR: Rank of the adapter matrices: higher rank, more trainable parameters.
help.loraDropout: Dropout applied to the LoRA layers during training.
help.targetModules: Linear layers of the model that receive the adapter.
help.optimizer: AdamW 8-bit reduces the memory of the optimizer state.
help.scheduler: How the learning rate changes during the run.
help.warmupSteps: Initial steps during which the learning rate ramps up from zero.
help.evalEvery: How often (in steps) the evaluation loss is computed.
help.seed: Seed for the adapter initialization and the data order.
